title: Cloudflare Model ID Alias Strategy
context: Cloudflare Workers AI model IDs use @cf/Provider/model format (e.g. @cf/meta/llama-3.1-8b-instruct). The system enriches models via global_metadata_repo.GetByModel() which does exact-match against model_metadata_global (populated from data/models.json). CF IDs never match, so models get zero enrichment metadata.

decisions.question: How to resolve CF model IDs to canonical names?
decisions.answer: Strip @cf/Provider/ prefix in GetByModel lookup. If modelName starts with @cf/ and has exactly 3 slash-separated parts, use the 3rd component as lookupName. Otherwise use modelName unchanged.

alternatives.reason: Creates duplicate entries for same model under different names. Fragile if CF changes naming. The alias approach is generic and extendable to other prefixed providers.

consequences: Simple, generic: extendable to other @-prefixed providers
Requires models.json entries to use canonical names that CF IDs strip to
No duplicate model entries in models.json
Lookup is transparent: callers pass full CF ID, get enrichment back
